page_title: WOL 2-2 HOF | Wolfsburg v Hoffenheim 09/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Matthias Jollenbeck is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' OFF THE POST! Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
90+2' Here is a change. Andrej Kramaric is going off and Christian Ilzer gives the last tactical orders to Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim).
90+1' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) makes a strong challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Daniel Bauer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) replacing Mohamed Amoura.
88' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tom Bischof.

84' 2 - 2 What a finish by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim)! He latches on to a cross inside the penalty area, takes a good first touch, pulls the trigger and the cannon of a shot ricochets off the right post into the bottom corner.
83' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

81' 2 - 1 Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Lovro Majer. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 2:1.
81' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) will take the corner.
80' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
80' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
76' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
76' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
75' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
73' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
72' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) replaces Patrick Wimmer.
71' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.
71' That's the end of the game for Bazoumana Toure, who is replaced by Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim).
70' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
69' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:6.

65' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
64' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
62' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' A cross from Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
61' Problems for Daniel Bauer as Kilian Fischer is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Wolfsburg) replaces him.
59' The game is interrupted now, Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
57' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
53' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Oliver Baumann easily deals with the threat.
53' PENALTY APPEAL by Wolfsburg, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
51' Flag up against Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
51' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
49' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
46' The game is over for Jakub Kaminski. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) comes on for the second half.
46' Daniel Bauer makes a switch. Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is coming on in place of Aster Vranckx at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.

45' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Oliver Baumann sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.
43' A yellow card for a tackle by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim). Matthias Jollenbeck doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
42' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
40' One of the Hoffenheim players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
38' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

34' 1 - 1 Marius Bulter sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.

33' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
32' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) trips an opposition player and Matthias Jollenbeck signals a foul.
29' An attempted cross from Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
26' Corner kicks – 1:2.
26' Wonderful pass from Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) for Bazoumana Toure, but they can't profit from it as Kamil Grabara comes off his line to collect.
25' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
22' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
19' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

17' What a chance that is! Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
16' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

16' A sweet pass finds Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Oliver Baumann is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
15' 1:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
12' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
12' Now Hoffenheim have a corner.
11' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Kamil Grabara easily deals with the threat.
10' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kamil Grabara intercepts the ball.
7' A wild effort from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
5' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Kamil Grabara comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
1' 1 - 0 This is definitely not what Leo Ostigard (Hoffenheim) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:0.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
